title: Hermeus recent news
description: A white band of recent stories: the index label with a crop-mark button at its right end, then three cards, each a square image over a near-white panel with the title, a small coloured category square and a grey date. Three columns on desktop, a swipeable rail with the next card peeking on phones. Titles turn amber on hover; the row fades up with the scroll.
notes: phones: a horizontal scroll-snap rail (no JavaScript)
the category square is amber (tone primary) or grey (tone muted)
